pageView.publishConfirm: Unpublish this note? Public records may be mirrored by firehose services and cannot be recalled.
pageView.publishHint: Public records are readable by anyone. Unpublishing deletes the record; firehose mirrors may retain copies.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.name: Name
settings.customPaletteHint: Tokens: surface, surface2, surface3, border, borderStrong, text, textSecondary, accent, accentSoft, danger, dangerSoft, ok, warning. Missing tokens fall back to the default theme.
settings.themeError: Custom palette is not valid JSON of token -> color.
settings.templateHint: New daily notes render this Typst source. Placeholders: {'{date}'}, {'{weekday}'}, {'{previous}'} (nearest previous note) and {'{next}'} (nearest next note).
settings.preludeHint: Appended before every page compile (editor, previews, published pages). Use new Typst functions or #set rules here to build custom views.
settings.aiEnableHint: Off by default: nothing is generated or sent to a provider until you enable this.
settings.keysHint: Keys stay in local.json, never in synced settings.
settings.syncSignInHint: Sign in with an atproto account to attach a space. The workspace keeps working offline; signing in only adds sync between devices.
settings.syncPlaintext: Record data is plaintext to every member of the space.
settings.syncRelayOff: Live relay offline; edits still sync through the PDS.
settings.syncRequiresServer: Sync requires the app server (OAuth client metadata). Running a static build keeps this workspace fully local.
settings.systemFontsHint: Installs every system font into the Typst engine, so documents can use any installed family.
settings.cannotEnumerate: This browser cannot enumerate system fonts.
settings.textSizeHint: Base text size in pt. 1 pt renders as 1 px on screen, so 16pt matches the editor's 16px text.

aiMenu.enableConfirm: AI generation is off. Enable it and configure a provider in Settings?
aiMenu.hint: Calls go direct to your configured provider. Keys live in local.json.

switcher.title: Open a workspace
switcher.noWorkspaces: No workspaces yet. Create one below.
switcher.deleteConfirm: Delete workspace "{name}" and all its pages? This cannot be undone.
switcher.hint: Each workspace syncs as its own space; data never mixes.

palette.label: Search pages and blocks
palette.prompt: Type to search every block in the workspace.

calendar.description: Pick a day to open or create its note. Days with notes are marked; use the trash to delete one.
calendar.deleteConfirm: Delete the daily note for {date}? This cannot be undone.

categories.hint: Name a category to group pages in the sidebar.
categories.label: Category name
categories.removeConfirm: Delete category "{name}"? Pages keep existing but become uncategorized.
